chirality-change.rationale: This new, unaccepted candidate skill is reusable by HELPS_HUMANS, WORKING_ITEMS, and TASK for authorized Chirality repository work. It adds no method-level tool restriction; actual execution remains the intersection of host, role, brief, write scope, and project policy. HELP_HUMAN may inspect the catalog and skill metadata through its read-only role without being eligible to execute the skill. Historical change workflow identities retain their explicit legacy policy.

deliverable-consistency.rationale: Retain the bounded deterministic deliverable scanner command.

drawing-titleblock-page.rationale: Retain the explicit empty command allowance, which denies shell commands rather than inheriting them.

preparation.rationale: This new, unaccepted candidate skill's operations are bounded scaffold and metadata preparation, so HELPS_HUMANS, WORKING_ITEMS, or TASK may use it when the active brief assigns that work; the method has no operation-specific reason to require the former TASK identity. The preserved capability list is only a method ceiling and does not add any host, role, brief, write, command, or delegation capability; TASK remains nondelegating. HELP_HUMAN may inspect the catalog and skill metadata through its read-only role without being eligible to execute the skill. Historical preparation workflow identities retain their explicit legacy policy.

proposal-format.rationale: Retain the explicit empty command allowance for this reasoning-only formatting method.

researcher.rationale: This new, unaccepted candidate skill's operations are bounded accepted-domain inquiry and evidence-packet production, so HELPS_HUMANS, WORKING_ITEMS, or TASK may use it when the active brief assigns that work; WORKING_ITEMS orchestration is a normal route rather than an exclusive identity. The preserved capability list is only a method ceiling and does not add any host, role, brief, write, command, or delegation capability; TASK remains nondelegating. HELP_HUMAN may inspect the catalog and skill metadata through its read-only role without being eligible to execute the skill. Historical researcher workflow identities retain their explicit legacy policy.

software-code-review.rationale: Retain the four review and scope-validation commands used by the bounded review method.

software-defect-diagnosis.rationale: Retain the repository discovery, affected-check selection, and registered-check execution commands.

absenceSemantics: No additional method restriction; executionRoleIds list all roles in agents/registry.json and execution is omitted.
emptyCompatibleRolesSemantics: Valid explicit deny-all for execution eligibility; discovery and read-only inspection remain separate. Absence inherits the applicable outer role policy, while a non-list value is malformed.
